# 💳 Share Drive Folder (gws CLI)

💳 Requires a paid Google Workspace account for the gws CLI — no free tier. Curated by Skill Harbor — a step-by-step recipe that finds a Drive folder, grants editor or viewer roles to collaborators (`gws drive permissions create` with role writer or reader), and verifies the grants by listing permissions. Distinct from the sibling recipe organize-drive-folder (lot 31): that one structures a folder's contents; this one is purely about sharing and permission verification. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: the recipe assumes the gws-drive utility skill is loaded and the gws binary is installed and authenticated; sharing a folder exposes everything inside it — confirm the folder contents and the recipients' roles before granting, especially writer access. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
